title: Results table: the friction ramp
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Forces, magnets and light (Mighty Metals and Why Do Cat's Eyes Glow at Night?)
source: Written for science/y3 lesson 10 (Results table: friction ramp (portal worksheet, printable or on a drawing tablet))
intro: Measure how far the car rolls each time, in centimetres.

questions.q: Which surface had the most friction? How do you know?
questions.a: The surface where the car went the shortest distance (usually the towel).
